fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HMO providers, Broker, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), HRBP, Employees
fields.Trigger: Annual renewal; program redesign; enrollment window

workflows.name: Employee Benefits Program Design, Enrollment & Annual Renewal (HMO/Medical)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-collect of "collect utilization data" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-122 (ensure pay equity & statutory benefits compliance.)
- operational: plan redesign, negotiation, and utilization management; operational: controls and self-service (links to VS-103)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-spike risk**: Double-digit renewal increases breach budget; mitigated by plan redesign, negotiation, and utilization management
- **Enrollment-error risk**: Wrong elections/deductions create employee disputes; mitigated by controls and self-service (links to VS-103.1)
System Touchpoints: - Benefits administration platform; payroll (links to VS-19.2); vendor (links to VS-34.2); HRIS (links to VS-29.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager design/maintain the HMO/medical benefits program: plan tiers (employee/dependent/level), coverage (inpatient/outpatient/ER), provider network, co-pay, and employee cost-share; benchmark competitiveness (W3308) and cost (W3320)

C&B Manager conduct annual renewal: collect utilization data (W3320), negotiate rates/terms with HMO and broker (links to VS-34.2), secure budget approval (W3327), and execute renewal; run open-enrollment for employee elections

C&B Manager/Payroll process enrollment changes, dependent adds/drops, and premium deductions via payroll (links to VS-19.2); handle eligibility/life-event changes (W3318) and maintain the benefits master

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Payroll (links to VS-19.2 W1527/W1306), Legal (links to VS-100), Government Affairs (links to VS-104)
fields.Trigger: Monthly statutory cycle; regulatory change (links to VS-22.3)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor regulatory change" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "generate and submit government-portal files" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "audit statutory compliance across 5 entities" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-122 (ensure pay equity & statutory benefits compliance.)
- operational: monthly discipline and reconciliation (links to VS-19); operational: change monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-remittance risk**: Late/short remittance triggers penalties and DOLE/BIR exposure; mitigated by monthly discipline and reconciliation (links to VS-19.2 W1306)
- **Regulatory-lag risk**: Outdated tables create wrong contributions; mitigated by change monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Payroll/statutory (links to VS-19.2 W1527/W1306); government portals (links to VS-22.3); audit (links to VS-22.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager maintain statutory-benefits program parameters (SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG contribution tables, employer/employee share, PRN generation) in line with current law; monitor regulatory change (links to VS-22.3) and government liaison (links to VS-104)

Payroll (links to VS-19.2) compute and remit monthly contributions per entity, generate and submit government-portal files, reconcile to payroll, and handle employee inquiries (SSS loans, Pag-IBIG claims)
C&B Manager audit statutory compliance across 5 entities, support government audit/inspection response (links to VS-22.2), and report compliance to CHRO/Legal

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Finance/Treasury (links to VS-18), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Separation (links to VS-19.5), Trustee/Fund Manager

workflows.name: Retirement, Pension & Long-Service Benefit Program Management

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate funding with Treasury" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review actuarial assumptions, funding ratio, and PFRS disclosure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
- operational: actuarial review and funding plan; operational: legal review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-funding risk**: Funding shortfall creates liability and PFRS charge; mitigated by actuarial review and funding plan
- **Compliance risk**: Non-compliant retirement pay triggers DOLE claims (links to VS-84/VS-100); mitigated by legal review
System Touchpoints: - Benefits platform; payroll/final pay (links to VS-19.2/VS-19.5); treasury/fund (links to VS-18); GL/PFRS (links to VS-17.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager design/maintain the retirement benefit program (defined-benefit or defined-contribution, trust fund, vesting) compliant with Retirement Pay Law (RA 7641); coordinate funding with Treasury (links to VS-18) and actuarial valuation with Finance (links to VS-17.1)

C&B Manager/Payroll process retirement and long-service benefits on separation (links to VS-19.5 W643 final pay), compute retirement pay per law/plan, coordinate trust-fund release with trustee, and tax-treat per BIR (links to VS-79)
C&B Manager/Finance review actuarial assumptions, funding ratio, and PFRS disclosure (links to VS-17.1/VS-17.4); report to CHRO/CFO and audit (links to VS-21.1)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Payroll (links to VS-19.2/VS-34), Employees, Managers, Finance (links to VS-17.1)
fields.Trigger: Allowance policy; reimbursement request; flexible-benefit election

workflows.name: Employee Allowances, Reimbursements & Flexible Benefits Administration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-submit of "submit reimbursements via expense process" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report allowance/reimbursement spend to Finance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
- operational: controls and audit; operational: payroll discipline (links to VS-19)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Policy-abuse risk**: Ineligible reimbursements/allowances inflate cost; mitigated by controls and audit
- **Tax-error risk**: Wrong tax treatment creates BIR exposure (links to VS-79); mitigated by payroll discipline (links to VS-19.2)
System Touchpoints: - Benefits/allowance platform; payroll (links to VS-19.2); expense (links to VS-34.3); GL (links to VS-17.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager administer allowance programs (transport, meal, communication, clothing/uniform, rice, COLA) per policy and statutory treatment; configure into payroll (links to VS-19.2) with tax-treatment (links to VS-79)

Employees submit reimbursements via expense process (links to VS-34.3/W74); Managers approve per authority matrix; Payroll/Finance process and reimburse with proper tax and GL coding (links to VS-17.1)
C&B Manager administer flexible/cafeteria benefits elections and balances, enforce limits and tax rules, and report allowance/reimbursement spend to Finance (links to VS-17.1/W3320)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Occupational Health (links to VS-83), EAP provider, Wellness vendors, HRBP

workflows.name: Wellness, EAP & Lifestyle Benefit Program Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "C&B Manager operate the programs" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report ROI to CHRO" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
- operational: promotion and outcome measurement; operational: vendor controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-utilization risk**: Underused programs waste budget; mitigated by promotion and outcome measurement
- **Confidentiality risk**: EAP/wellness data privacy breach (links to VS-91); mitigated by vendor controls
System Touchpoints: - Benefits platform; occupational health (links to VS-83); EAP vendor; analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager design/maintain wellness, employee-assistance (EAP), and lifestyle benefit programs (gym subsidy, mental-health support, financial wellness, family support); integrate with occupational health (links to VS-83.3 EAP) and engagement (links to VS-103.2)

C&B Manager operate the programs: vendor delivery (links to VS-34.2), utilization tracking (W3320), confidentiality (EAP privacy links to VS-91), and employee communication/promotion; coordinate referrals from occupational health (links to VS-83)
C&B Manager measure wellness-program outcomes (participation, health-risk reduction, engagement impact links to VS-103.2, absence reduction) and report ROI to CHRO; adjust program mix

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HRBP, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Occupational Health (links to VS-83), Employees
fields.Trigger: Employee life event (marriage, birth, adoption, death, illness)

workflows.name: Dependent & Life-Event Benefits Management (Maternity, Paternity, Bereavement)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentation and eligibility" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate pay during leave" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track life-event benefit utilization and compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
- operational: policy and verification; operational: privacy controls (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-compliance risk**: Wrong leave/pay creates DOLE exposure (links to VS-84); mitigated by policy and verification
- **Privacy risk**: Life-event data is sensitive; mitigated by privacy controls (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Benefits/leave platform; payroll (links to VS-19.2); HMO (W3313); SSS (W3314); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: HRBP/C&B Manager process life-event benefits: maternity (105-day expanded per RA 11210), paternity (7-day), solo-parent (7-day), bereavement, marriage, and adoption leave per policy/law (links to VS-19.2 leave); verify documentation and eligibility
C&B Manager/Payroll coordinate pay during leave (SSS maternity benefit per W3314, company top-up), dependent HMO adds (W3313), and statutory notifications; manage coverage continuity
C&B Manager track life-event benefit utilization and compliance (Expanded Maternity Leave, Solo Parents Welfare Act), report metrics, and ensure sensitive data privacy (links to VS-91)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Procurement (links to VS-34.2), Legal (links to VS-100), Finance (links to VS-17.1)
fields.Trigger: Vendor renewal; performance issue; sourcing (links to VS-34)
fields.Volume: HMOs, brokers, insurers, retirement fund, EAP, wellness vendors

workflows.name: Benefits Vendor Management, Broker & Provider Relations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "C&B Manager manage vendor performance against SLA" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report vendor performance and spend" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
- operational: SLA and review; operational: DPA and due diligence
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vendor-failure risk**: Poor vendor service disrupts employee benefits; mitigated by SLA and review
- **Data-sharing risk**: Vendor mishandles employee health data (links to VS-91); mitigated by DPA and due diligence
System Touchpoints: - Vendor management (links to VS-34.2); contract (links to VS-100); GL/AP (links to VS-15/VS-17.1); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/Procurement (links to VS-34.2) select and contract benefits vendors/brokers: RFP, due diligence, contract terms (SLA, data-protection per VS-91, fee), and authority approval; maintain vendor master

C&B Manager manage vendor performance against SLA (claims turnaround, network adequacy, service quality), resolve issues, and conduct periodic business reviews; coordinate provider network adequacy across 200 store regions
C&B Manager/Legal manage contract renewals/terminations and transitions, ensure continuity of coverage for employees, and report vendor performance and spend (links to VS-34.2)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4), BI (links to VS-28.1), CHRO/CFO

workflows.name: Benefits Cost Modeling, Total-Cost & Utilization Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-model of "model total benefits cost" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "analyze utilization" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report benefits total-cost, utilization, and ROI to CHRO/CFO" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-536 (ensure controlled execution — Benefits, Wellness Programs & Statutory Administration (PA-102.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-blindness risk**: Untracked utilization drives unexpected renewal hikes; mitigated by analytics
- **ROI-blindness risk**: Ineffective programs retained; mitigated by outcome measurement (W3328)
System Touchpoints: - Benefits analytics (links to VS-28.1); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); HMO/claims data

steps.activity: C&B Manager/Finance model total benefits cost (HMO, statutory, retirement, allowances, wellness) per employee and as % of payroll/revenue; project cost under renewal/program-change scenarios

C&B Manager/BI analyze utilization (HMO claims, EAP usage, retirement take-up, leave) by demographic/segment, identify cost drivers and opportunities (plan redesign, wellness intervention links to VS-83/W3317)
C&B Manager report benefits total-cost, utilization, and ROI to CHRO/CFO; feed into benefits budget (W3327) and total-rewards effectiveness (W3328); benchmark to market
